items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 23:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to tell the children of Israel that the feasts of the LORD, which they are to proclaim as holy convocations, belong to the LORD.
items.object: the feasts of the LORD as holy convocations
